name: RWP Shop
author: React-WP
description: A WooCommerce-style store: products with variations, cart, checkout, orders, coupons, tax, shipping zones, Stripe, PayPal and offline payments, customer accounts, reviews, reports and order emails.

retains: Shop site templates (Shop, Product, Cart, Checkout, My Account) stay in Pages as ordinary builder layouts.
The shop_manager role stays on existing accounts; without the shop it grants nothing extra.
Likes, saved items and view counts of products stay in the core engagement tables, keyed by product id.
